exposure: Management strategies for major obstetric hemorrhage prior to peripartum hysterectomy (uterotonics administration, intrauterine balloon use, interventional radiology)
Country of study (Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Italy, the Netherlands, Slovakia, Sweden, UK)
cohort: The study included 1302 women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy due to obstetric hemorrhage, with procedures performed from 22 gestational weeks up to 48 hours postpartum.
finding: Management strategies for obstetric hemorrhage leading to peripartum hysterectomy varied greatly between nine European countries and were associated with substantial adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
country: Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Italy, the Netherlands, Slovakia, Sweden, UK
followup_time: Outcomes assessed during the peripartum period and immediate post-hysterectomy hospitalization.
